texto.es: Patrick revisa tu espacio en persona y te da un precio competitivo, con fotos de proyectos anteriores.
texto.en: Patrick reviews your space in person and gives you a competitive quote, with photos of past projects.

texto.es: Recogemos y entregamos tu piso nuevo, y lo dejamos aclimatarse los días que necesite antes de instalar.
texto.en: We pick up and deliver your new flooring, letting it acclimate for however many days it needs before install.

texto.es: Terminamos en el plazo acordado, atendiendo cada detalle grande y pequeño.
texto.en: We finish within the agreed timeframe, tending to every large and small detail.

texto.es: Limpiamos el aserrín y los escombros, y ayudamos a regresar muebles y alfombras a su lugar.
texto.en: We clean up sawdust and debris, and help move your furniture and rugs back into place.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el material y el espacio. Llama y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted on the material and the space. Call and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

items.quote: We couldn't be happier with the outstanding job PW Flooring Installation did installing our new vinyl floors! From the very first consultation to the final installation, the team was professional, friendly, knowledgeable, and truly cared about making sure everything was perfect.

Patrick and PW Flooring were spectacular! They came on time to review my project, provided a competitive quote, and shared completion photos of previous projects. They completed the installation in the scheduled timeframe and did a perfect job, tending to every large and small detail.

Patrick was professional, easy to work with, and delivered outstanding results on my garage floor. He communicated clearly, showed up on time, and made the entire process smooth from start to finish. I highly recommend Patrick for quality workmanship and excellent service.
